name: Hario Skerton Plus
details: Hand grinder with ceramic conical burrs and a notched adjustment (the original Skerton uses the same chart).

notes.turkish: Honest Coffee Guide lists no Turkish range.

rangeInfo.note: Honest Coffee Guide's chart (community, not the manufacturer's): espresso 1, moka pot 2–3, AeroPress 1–5, V60 2–3, filter coffee machine 1–5, French press 4–8, cold brew 5–9; Turkish N/A. Its V60 row is used for pour-over, “Filter Coffee Machine” for drip, French press for immersion.
rangeInfo.estimateNote: Estimated by extrapolating the cited ranges, not from the source: Rapid Brewer: from the middle of the AeroPress range to the middle of the pour-over range. Dial in from there.
